chapter: 事业相关各处(六亲属类、冲克、应举、文书、谒见、六亲爻动变、六神爻动)
chapter_en: Career passages (the classes of the six relations, clash and control, the examination, documents, calling on someone, the six relations moving and changing, the six spirits moving)

units.chapter_en: The classes of the six relations
units.title: 六亲属类·父母主文书吏、印绶、官职事业、图籍号令、差劄条敕；官鬼主君主、职清、公庭

rule.yi: 父母爻代表尊长、文书、吏员，印绶、衣服、轿车船，契约、本事，还有文章、印绶、官职事业、图籍号令、差遣的札子和条文敕令；官鬼爻代表神邪、疾病、鬼祟、盗贼，失物、输赢、灾祸，还有君主、职位清要、公庭。
rule.en: The Resource line stands for elders, documents and clerks, the seal and ribbon, clothing, sedan chairs, carts and boats, contracts and skills, and also essays, the seal and ribbon, office and career, maps and registers, orders and commands, dispatch notes, regulations and decrees; the Pressure line stands for spirits and evil, illness, hauntings and thieves, lost things, winning and losing and disaster, and also the sovereign, clear and weighty posts, and the public court.

yi: 父母（爻）是尊长、文书、吏员，
印绶、衣服、轿、车、船，
契约、本事，操心用力，
天地、坟墓、房屋、田园。
en: Resource is elders, documents and clerks,
the seal and ribbon, clothing, sedan chairs, carts and boats,
contracts and skills, taxing the mind and strength,
heaven and earth, graves, houses, fields and gardens.

yi: 文章、印绶，
官职、事业，
图籍、号令，
差遣的札子、条文敕令。
en: essays and the seal and ribbon,
office and career,
maps and registers, orders and commands,
dispatch notes, regulations and decrees.

yi: 官鬼（爻）主神邪、疾病、鬼祟、盗贼，
失物、输赢、灾祸、梦、忧愁，
电闪、主人、厅堂殿宇一类，
沟渠、牢狱、臀尻，制住自身的忧愁。
en: Pressure stands for spirits and evil, illness, hauntings and thieves,
lost things, winning and losing, disaster, dreams and worry,
lightning, the master, halls and palaces and the like,
ditches, prisons, the buttocks, and the worry of being held in check.

yi: 官鬼（爻）事发，
（象征）君主、清要的职位，
en: When the Pressure line's matter arises,
it stands for the sovereign and clear and weighty posts,

yi: 公庭、东面的道路，
en: the public court, the road to the east,

note.yi: 这是一份各类事物归属六亲的名目表，各问题通用；这里只引和官职有关的几句，其余几行（财、福、兄）见求财、婚姻等篇。海底眼另有一段「此尾五句应在官鬼上，未知是否，存考」的小注，不引。
note.en: This is a general list assigning things to the six relations, common to every kind of question; only the lines bearing on office are quoted here, and the other lines (Wealth, Output, Peer) are in the chapters on wealth, marriage and so on. The Haidi Yan also has a small note saying that the last five phrases may belong to Pressure but this is uncertain and kept for study, which is not quoted.

units.title: 冲克官鬼：官鬼被冲克即主求官，又关诉讼、走失、盗贼，不要一例看

rule.yi: 官鬼爻被冲克，就是（占）求官，还有诉讼的事暗中相关，又可能是走失、盗贼，不要把爻里的情形当成一个例子来看。
rule.en: The Pressure line clashed and controlled means the seeking of office, and a lawsuit is hiddenly connected, or perhaps something strayed or lost and thieves; do not read what is in the line as a single case.

yi: 冲克官鬼（这一条）：
官鬼被冲克，就是（占）求官，
还有诉讼的事暗中相关，
又可能是走失、还有盗贼，
不要把爻里的情形当成一个例子来看。
en: Clash and control on Pressure:
Pressure clashed and controlled is the seeking of office,
and a lawsuit is hiddenly connected,
or perhaps something strayed or lost, and thieves,
do not read what is in the line as a single case.

units.title: 应举章·赴诏面君宜官鬼出现、鬼墓发动不须推；除迁以鬼爻持世（鬼发或临鬼墓不吉）；求职请判在任宜鬼爻静、鬼发或动子出有替

rule.yi: 赴诏、面见君主，宜官鬼出现；官鬼的墓发动，不必再推。除迁（任命调迁），以官鬼爻持世为宜，官鬼发动、或落在鬼墓上，就不吉利。求职、请求考核评定，在任的人宜官鬼爻安静；官鬼发动，或子孙发动出来，就有人接替。
rule.en: For going to court on summons or seeing the sovereign, it is fitting that Pressure appear; the tomb of Pressure moving needs no further reckoning. For appointment and transfer it is right that the Pressure line hold the Self, and if Pressure moves or stands on the tomb of Pressure it is not auspicious. For seeking a post or an appraisal, one in office should have the Pressure line still; if Pressure moves, or Output moves out, there is a replacement.

yi: 赴诏、面见君主的殿堂，
宜官鬼出现；
官鬼的墓发动，不必再推。
en: Going on summons, to see the sovereign in the hall,
it is fitting that Pressure appear;
the tomb of Pressure moving needs no further reckoning.

yi: 除迁（任命调迁），以官鬼爻持世为宜；
官鬼如果发动，
或者落在鬼墓上，
就不吉利。
en: For appointment and transfer it is right that the Pressure line hold the Self;
if Pressure moves,
or stands on the tomb of Pressure,
it is not auspicious.

yi: 求职、请求考核评定，
在任的人宜官鬼爻安静；
官鬼发动，或者子孙发动出来，
就有人接替。
en: To seek a post or ask for an appraisal,
one in office should have the Pressure line still;
if Pressure moves, or Output moves out,
there is a replacement.

note.yi: 这三句在「应举」一段里，但说的是做官的人：赴诏、除迁、求职请判、在任，不是考试。第三句和火珠林占科举之前「求职请判」一段（HZL.02）是同一句话。「鬼墓发动不须推」没有说为什么不用再推，按字面译。
note.en: These three passages stand in the section on taking the examination but speak of men holding office: going on summons, appointment and transfer, seeking a post or appraisal, and being in office, not of examinations. The third is the same sentence as the 'seeking a post or appraisal' passage in the Huozhulin (HZL.02). 'The tomb of Pressure moving needs no further reckoning' does not say why, and is translated literally.

units.title: 文书章·见贵求谋问立身：文书不动及时辰，财动文书空费力，子动伤官事不亨；事见两爻须再觅、官多宛转恐艰难，最要日辰生合出则知音处处得前程

rule.yi: 拜见贵人、求谋、问立身：文书（父母）不动、又赶上时辰，可成；财动，文书白费力；子孙动，伤了官鬼，事情不亨通。事情现出两个爻，要再去找；官多，辗转曲折，恐怕艰难；最要紧的是日辰生合它、让它出来，那就处处遇到知音、得到前程。
rule.en: For calling on a noble, scheming for a post and asking about establishing oneself: with the documents (Resource) still and in step with the time it can be done; Wealth moving, the documents are spent in vain; Output moving injures Pressure and the matter does not go through. If the matter shows two lines, seek again; with many Pressure lines it winds and turns and may be hard; what matters most is that the Day generates or combines and brings it out, and then one finds those who know one everywhere and a future.

yi: 拜见贵人、求谋、问立身处世，
文书（父母）不动、又赶上时辰，
财动，文书白费力气；
子孙动，伤了官鬼，事情不亨通。
en: To call on a noble, to scheme for a post, to ask how to establish oneself,
the documents (Resource) still and in step with the time,
Wealth moving, the documents are spent in vain;
Output moving injures Pressure and the matter does not go through.

yi: 它又说：
事情现出两个爻，要再去找；
官多，辗转曲折，恐怕艰难；
最要紧的是日辰生合它、让它出来，
那就处处遇到知音、得到前程。
en: It says again:
if the matter shows two lines, seek again;
with many Pressure lines it winds and turns and may be hard;
what matters most is that the Day generates or combines and brings it out,
and then one finds those who know one everywhere and a future.

units.title: 文书章：六爻中只一爻动最忌兄弟动；文书与贵人原无亦难成，出现有气亦怕空亡；求官与文书要旺相持世有成；应爻不克事体分明；乾兑坎宫谋事不一；见官用动其人多出

rule.yi: 六爻中如果只有一爻动，最忌讳兄弟爻动，事情不实在、难成。如果文书和贵人在卦中原本没有，也难成；出现了、有气，也怕空亡——所说的动爻急得像火攻，急着落入空亡。求官和文书，要旺相、持世才有成。应爻不受克，事体就分明；乾、兑、坎宫，谋事不专一；见官员，用爻发动，那人多半出门，叫也是白叫。
rule.en: If only one line moves among the six, what is most to be avoided is Peer moving: the matter is not real and is hard to accomplish. If the documents and the Noble are originally absent from the hexagram, it is also hard to accomplish; if they appear and have qi they still fear Void, as is said, a moving line is urgent like an attack by fire, hurrying into Void. For seeking office and documents, they must be strong and hold the Self to succeed. If the Other line is not controlled, the matter is clear; in the palaces Qian, Dui and Kan the planning is not single-minded; in seeing an official, if the Subject line moves, the man has mostly gone out, and calling for him is in vain.

yi: 如果六爻之中，
只有一爻发动，
最忌讳兄弟爻动，
事情不实在，难以成功。
en: If among the six lines
only one line moves,
what is most to be avoided is Peer moving,
the matter is not real and is hard to accomplish.

zh: 若文书与贵人卦中原无事，
yi: 如果文书和贵人在卦中原本没有这回事，
也难成功。
出现了、有气，
也怕空亡，
所说的动爻急得像火攻，
急着落入空亡。
求官和文书，
要旺相、持世才有成。
en: If the documents and the Noble are originally absent from the hexagram,
it is also hard to accomplish.
if they appear and have qi,
they still fear Void,
as is said, a moving line is urgent like an attack by fire,
hurrying into Void.
For seeking office and documents,
they must be strong and hold the Self to succeed.

yi: 应爻不受克，
事体就分明；
乾、兑、坎宫，
谋事不专一。
见官员，用爻发动，
那人多半出门，叫也是白叫。
en: If the Other line is not controlled,
the matter is clear;
in the palaces Qian, Dui and Kan,
the planning is not single-minded.
in seeing an official, if the Subject line moves,
the man has mostly gone out, and calling for him is in vain.

units.title: 谒见：谒人须问谒何人，世应作鬼枉劳心，用爻出现不乘旺往见必不在家；世应坐鬼彼此疑心，用爻衰弱我何籍焉

rule.yi: 拜谒人，要问拜谒的是谁；世、应作鬼，白费心思；用爻出现却不乘旺，去见他必定不在家。世、应坐着官鬼，双方互相猜疑；如果用爻衰弱了，我还能凭靠什么呢？
rule.en: In calling on someone, ask whom one is calling on; with the Self or the Other as Pressure one wearies the mind in vain; the Subject line appearing but not riding strength, going to see him, he is surely not at home. With the Self or the Other sitting on Pressure, each suspects the other; with the Subject line weak, on what could I rely?

yi: 拜谒人，要问拜谒的是什么人；
世、应作了鬼，白费心思；
用爻出现却不乘旺，
去见他，一定不在家里。
en: In calling on someone, ask whom one is calling on;
with the Self or the Other as Pressure, one wearies the mind in vain;
the Subject line appearing but not riding strength,
going to see him, he is surely not at home.

yi: 世、应坐着官鬼，
双方互相猜疑；
如果用爻衰弱了，
我还能凭靠什么呢？
en: With the Self or the Other sitting on Pressure,
each suspects the other;
if the Subject line is weak,
on what could I rely?

dispute.yi: 断易天机转引的这首（「海底眼云」），第一二句作「世应坐鬼枉劳心」，第三句作「用爻出现不乘土」；这里作「世应作鬼」「用爻出现不乘旺」。「坐」「作」一字之差关系不大，但「不乘土」和「不乘旺」差得远：前者说用爻没有落在土爻上，后者说用爻没有得旺。两本都没有解释，本库各照原书录，不裁定。
dispute.en: The poem as quoted in the Duanyi Tianji ('the Eye at the Bottom of the Sea says') has 'the Self or the Other sitting on Pressure, the mind wearied in vain' in its first two lines and 'the Subject line appearing but not riding Earth' in the third, while here it reads 'the Self or the Other as Pressure' and 'not riding strength'. The one-word difference between 'sit' and 'be' matters little, but 'not riding Earth' and 'not riding strength' are far apart: the first says the Subject line does not stand on an Earth line, the second that it has not gained strength. Neither book explains it, and each is recorded as its book gives it, without adjudication.

units.title: 六亲爻动·求官谒贵：子动谒贵求官休进用（主用被伤）、守旧当占可自然；妻财动克文书应举求官总是虚；官鬼动更改动谋皆不行

rule.yi: 子孙发动，谒见贵人、求官不要进取（主用爻被伤），守旧倒还可以顺其自然；妻财发动克了文书，应举、求官总是落空（文书受伤）；官鬼发动，更改、动谋都不行（鬼动，所以受阻隔）。
rule.en: With Output moving, do not press forward in calling on a noble or seeking office (the Subject line is injured), and holding to the old can be left to take its course; with Wealth moving and controlling the documents, taking the examination or seeking office is all empty (the documents are injured); with Pressure moving, neither changes nor schemes will do (Pressure moving brings obstruction).

zh: 谒贵求官休进用（主用被伤），
yi: 谒见贵人、求官，不要进取（主用爻被伤）；
守着旧的、就这样占问，倒可以顺其自然。
en: calling on a noble or seeking office, do not press forward (the Subject line is injured);
holding to the old, in such a divination it can be left to take its course.

zh: 妻财发用克文书（财能克文），
应举求官总是虚（文书受伤），
yi: 妻财发动，克了文书（财能克文），
应举、求官总是落空（文书受伤），
en: Wealth moving and controlling the documents (Wealth can control the documents),
taking the examination or seeking office is all empty (the documents are injured),

zh: 更改动谋皆不行（鬼动阻隔）。
yi: 更改、动谋都不行（鬼动，所以受阻隔）。
en: neither changes nor schemes will do (Pressure moving brings obstruction).

note.yi: 「守旧当占可自然」意思不清，这里按「守着旧的、就此占问，可顺其自然」译，不确定。这一段是各问题通用的歌，每句括号里的小注是原书的。
note.en: 'Hold to the old, in such a divination it is natural' is unclear in sense and is translated as 'holding to the old, in such a divination it can be left to take its course', which is uncertain. This is a song common to all kinds of questions, and the small notes in brackets after each line are the book's own.

units.title: 六亲爻变·官化官见贵求官事尽难（有名无实）、官化文书官未顺

rule.yi: 官化官，病没有安好；拜见贵人、求官，事事都难（有名无实）；官化文书，官运还不顺（官位高过文书，文书就难）；纵然忧愁、疾病，也还算吉。
rule.en: Pressure turning into Pressure, the illness is not yet settled; in calling on a noble or seeking office everything is hard (name without substance); Pressure turning into the documents, the office does not yet go smoothly (with Pressure ahead of the documents, the documents are hard); even so, worry and illness are still auspicious.

zh: 官化官兮病未安（谓之化去），
见贵求官事尽难（有名无实），
官化文书官未顺（官超文难），
纵能忧病还为吉（病凶亦吉）。
yi: 官化官，病就没有安好（小注：这叫化去）；
拜见贵人、求官，事事都难（小注：有名无实）；
官化文书，官运还不顺（小注：官位高过文书，文书就难）；
纵使忧愁、疾病，也还算吉（小注：病凶也吉）。
en: Pressure turning into Pressure, the illness is not yet settled (note: this is called turning away);
in calling on a noble or seeking office everything is hard (note: name without substance);
Pressure turning into the documents, the office does not yet go smoothly (note: with Pressure ahead of the documents, the documents are hard);
even so, worry and illness are still auspicious (note: a grave illness is also auspicious).

units.title: 六亲爻变·父化：父化同人多口舌、同求婉转须重叠；父化财交易利、家长不宁求事拙；父化官家误失、求官必得近高职、卦无父母事无头、休囚空费力

rule.yi: 父化同人，多有口舌；一起求谋，要曲折婉转、重重叠叠（纵然成了也要重新更改）；父化财，做买卖有利（先难后易），家里长辈不安宁、求事笨拙（化成财克了父）；父化官，家里有耽误、有失（化成鬼，不适宜），求官必定得到靠近高位的职务（官、父两个月），卦里没有父母，事情没有头绪（父母是总体），再在休囚，白费力气（父母衰，后来劳苦）。
rule.en: Resource turning into a companion (Peer), there is much quarrelling; seeking together, it winds and turns and must be layered (even if it succeeds it must be changed again); Resource turning into Wealth, trading is profitable (hard first, then easy), but the elders of the house are unsettled and seeking a matter goes clumsily (turning into Wealth controls Resource); Resource turning into Pressure, the household suffers delay and loss (turning into Pressure is unsuitable), and seeking office one is sure to get a post near a high one (the two months of Pressure and Resource); with no Resource in the hexagram the matter has no head (Resource is the whole body), and if it is also at rest or trapped, effort is spent in vain (Resource weak, labour afterwards).

zh: 父化同人多口舌（化兄是非），
同求婉转须重叠（纵成重更），
父化财兮交易利（先难后易），
家长不宁求事拙（化财克父）。
父化官兮家悮失（化鬼不宜），
求官必得近高职（官父两月），
卦无父母事无头（父为统体），
更在休囚空费力（父衰后劳）。
yi: 父化同人，多有口舌（小注：化兄，就有是非）；
一起求谋，要曲折婉转、重重叠叠（小注：纵然成了也要重新更改）；
父化财，做买卖有利（小注：先难后易）；
家里长辈不安宁，求事笨拙（小注：化成财克了父）。
父化官，家里有耽误、有失（小注：化成鬼，不适宜）；
求官必定得到靠近高位的职务（小注：官、父两个月）；
卦里没有父母，事情没有头绪（小注：父母是总体）；
再在休囚，白费力气（小注：父母衰，后来劳苦）。
en: Resource turning into a companion, there is much quarrelling (note: turning into Peer brings disputes);
seeking together, it winds and turns and must be layered (note: even if it succeeds it must be changed again);
Resource turning into Wealth, trading is profitable (note: hard first, then easy);
the elders of the house are unsettled and seeking a matter goes clumsily (note: turning into Wealth controls Resource).
Resource turning into Pressure, the household suffers delay and loss (note: turning into Pressure is unsuitable);
seeking office one is sure to get a post near a high one (note: the two months of Pressure and Resource);
with no Resource in the hexagram the matter has no head (note: Resource is the whole body);
and if it is also at rest or trapped, effort is spent in vain (note: Resource weak, labour afterwards).

note.yi: 「官父两月」小注没有解释，这里照字面译作「官、父两个月」，可能指官鬼、父母爻所值的月份，不确定。「父化同人」的「同人」，小注说是「化兄」，按兄弟译。「虎易注：此篇各节明显错乱」，海底眼这一整段原书就有今人标出的错乱，这几句的先后读起来也有跳跃。
note.en: The small note 'the two months of Pressure and Resource' is not explained and is translated literally; it may mean the months ruled by the Pressure and Resource lines, which is uncertain. For 'Resource turning into a companion', the small note says 'turning into Peer', and it is translated as Peer. A modern editor remarks of this part of the Haidi Yan that its sections are plainly in disorder, and these lines too read with jumps.

units.title: 六亲爻变·谋托：官化兄朋友诈、安托人心不似初；官化财财自得；官中无鬼难谋事、官员不见事空虚；托用人情不一心（托人不宜）

rule.yi: 官化兄，朋友有欺诈，安心托付的人心思已不像当初；官化财，钱财自然得到，赌博、抽签拈阄总不如意；官员里没有官鬼，难以谋事，官员不出现，事情落空；托人情办事，人不一条心（不适宜托人）。
rule.en: Pressure turning into Peer, friends are deceitful and the one trusted with a favour no longer has the heart he had at first; Pressure turning into Wealth, money comes of itself, but gambling and drawing lots are never as one wishes; with no Pressure in the office, planning a matter is hard, and with the official not appearing the matter is empty; relying on favours, hearts are not as one (it is not suitable to entrust it to others).

zh: 官化兄兮朋友诈（鬼兄诓诈），
官化财兮财自得（财能生官），
赌博抽拈总不如（件件不宜）。
官中无鬼难谋事（无鬼不成），
官员不见事空虚（见官无主）。
yi: 官化兄，朋友有欺诈（小注：鬼和兄都主诓骗欺诈）；
安心托付的人，心思已不像当初（小注：同上）；
官化财，钱财自然得到（小注：财能生官）；
赌博、抽签拈阄，总不如意（小注：件件都不适宜）。
官员里没有官鬼，难以谋事（小注：没有鬼就不成）；
官员不出现，事情落空（小注：见官没有主心骨）。
en: Pressure turning into Peer, friends are deceitful (note: Pressure and Peer both mean cheating and deceit);
the one trusted with a favour no longer has the heart he had at first (note: as above);
Pressure turning into Wealth, money comes of itself (note: Wealth can generate Pressure);
gambling and drawing lots are never as one wishes (note: none of them is suitable).
with no Pressure in the office, planning a matter is hard (note: without Pressure it cannot succeed);
with the official not appearing, the matter is empty (note: in seeing an official there is no master).

zh: 托用人情不一心（托人不宜）。
yi: 托人情办事，人不一条心（小注：不适宜托人）。
en: relying on favours, hearts are not as one (note: it is not suitable to entrust it to others).

units.title: 六神爻动·朱雀白虎：朱雀交重文印旺、杀神相并徒劳功、持水临空却利公；白虎交重惊怪事、求官临鬼反丰隆（虎官利名）

rule.yi: 朱雀交重发动，文书印绶旺（朱雀属火）；和杀神并在一起，就白劳功夫（并上凶神就没有文）；是非口舌都由此而来；持水、临空，反而有利于公事。白虎交重，是惊恐怪异之事（白虎属金）；求官时临在官鬼上，反而丰盛隆盛（虎与官有利于名）。
rule.en: With the Vermilion Bird moving heavily, the documents and the seal and ribbon are strong (the Vermilion Bird belongs to Fire); joined with a baleful spirit, the labour is spent in vain (joined to an ill spirit there are no documents); quarrels and gossip all come from this; holding Water or standing in the void, it is on the contrary favourable to public business. With the White Tiger moving heavily it is fright and strange things (the White Tiger belongs to Metal); in seeking office, standing on Pressure, it brings abundance and prosperity on the contrary (the Tiger and Pressure favour a name).

zh: 朱雀交重文印旺（朱雀属火）杀神相并谩劳功（并凶无文），
是非口舌皆因此（多主口舌），
持水临空却利公（临太空吉）。
yi: 朱雀交重发动，文书印绶旺（小注：朱雀属火），和杀神并在一起，就白劳功夫（小注：并上凶神就没有文），
是非口舌都由此而来（小注：多主口舌）；
持水、临空，反而有利于公事（小注：临太空为吉）。
en: the Vermilion Bird moving heavily, the documents and the seal and ribbon are strong (note: the Vermilion Bird belongs to Fire), joined with a baleful spirit, the labour is spent in vain (note: joined to an ill spirit there are no documents),
quarrels and gossip all come from this (note: it mostly means quarrels);
holding Water or standing in the void, it is on the contrary favourable to public business (note: standing in great void is auspicious).

zh: 白虎交重惊怪事（白虎属金），
求官临鬼反丰隆（虎官利名），
yi: 白虎交重，是惊恐怪异之事（小注：白虎属金）；
求官时临在官鬼上，反而丰盛隆盛（小注：虎与官有利于名）。
en: the White Tiger moving heavily, it is fright and strange things (note: the White Tiger belongs to Metal);
in seeking office, standing on Pressure, it brings abundance and prosperity on the contrary (note: the Tiger and Pressure favour a name).

note.yi: 白虎一般主凶，这里却说白虎交重、临官鬼时求官反而「丰隆」，是原文的说法，本库照录，不改；周易尚占里有同一句（「求官临鬼反丰隆」）。
note.en: The White Tiger generally stands for ill, yet here the White Tiger moving heavily on Pressure is said on the contrary to bring 'abundance' in seeking office, as the text has it; it is recorded as it stands and not altered, and the same line is in the Zhouyi Shangzhan ('seeking office on Pressure brings abundance on the contrary').
